# v0.4.0 expansion notes

The catalogue grows from 336 to 720 named recipes while preserving the six-opcode provider ABI.

## New families

- diagrams: generic flowchart and process-diagram geometry
- connectors: straight, orthogonal, curved, branching and endpoint markers
- patterns: reusable hatch and tile cells
- graph_symbols: node and edge vocabularies for graph editors
- annotations: speech/callout, crop, registration and focus helpers
- weather_symbols: simplified weather glyphs, wind barbs and front segments
- architecture: simplified plan-view doors, windows, walls, stairs and fixtures

## Expanded existing families

- mathematical curves, rose/Lissajous/cycloid-like recipes
- additional spiral constructions
- floral and geometric ornaments
- mechanical and logic technical symbols
- map/service symbols
- advanced editor gizmos
- stranger concave and star polygons
- widget/control primitives

## Standards boundary

These are backend-neutral geometric building blocks. Names inspired by established diagram, mapping, weather, electrical or process vocabularies identify useful geometric categories; they do not assert standards conformance, semantic interoperability, or certification. Applications that need exact IEC/BPMN/meteorological semantics should layer their own standards-specific mapping/provider on top.
